source: carnival.com per-deck colour-coded plan (FlateDecode image, tiled 4x, vision-transcribed)
sourceDetail: Deck images extracted from carnival.com per-deck PDFs, sliced into upscaled tiles and read by vision. Colour encodes category.

notes.completeness: 1555 cabins vs ~2641 published (58.9%). Category-accurate (colour-coded source). The densest inner-Interior clusters on the largest decks were omitted (not guessed) even at 4x tiling — a finer re-tile (6-8 tiles/deck) would recover them.
notes.port_starboard_caveat: side = top-row/bottom-row heuristic, unvalidated (could be mirrored).
